capabilities: Render multi-stock tables with sparklines via stock-block-list code blocks
Chart a single stock or crypto as a line or candlestick chart
Fetch current and historical prices from Yahoo Finance
Detect currencies from stock exchange suffixes
Auto-refresh block data at configured intervals
extras: No API key required; the README emphasizes supply-chain security (SHA256 checksums, immutable GitHub releases) and includes an educational-use disclaimer, warning that data should not be the sole basis for investment decisions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display live market prices or price charts inside notes.

relations.evidence: The plugin fetches real stock and crypto data from Yahoo Finance API
To test the newest versions of the plugin before official releases, you can install the beta builds using the BRAT plugin.

summary: Renders stock and crypto prices, changes, and sparkline or candlestick charts in notes via stock-block code blocks using Yahoo Finance data.
